design.primary_reference: Currently qualified native64, full-depth CED-disabled attention with existing confidence/head6.
design.candidate_dispatch: Runner installs persistent cone/backbone/DSpark+HotRows adaptation for fastpath64. Plain bench.main would run identical arms and is not an authorized execution of this plan.
design.performance_gate: Do not begin performance plan before mandatory boundary/state tests pass or every unsupported geometry has a verified full-native fallback. Freeze runner/source manifest before the first model outcome; plans must not change afterwards.
design.history_policy: Within a suite use one model process; fresh request KV; no OS cache purge. Candidate row-cache history persists; baseline bypass retains allocated history. Log per-table hits/misses/bytes and report first-use versus subsequent reuse. Separate suites may use separate loads; do not mix summaries.
design.timing_policy: Boundary timings diagnostic only. Performance has one pair per source/length; report each pair and length strata, without claiming confidence intervals or independent cold replicates. Do not aggregate boundary timing into performance.
design.divergence_policy: Retain all complete observations and exact first differing token/trace; disallow token-identical speed claims on divergence. A crash/earlyEOS/incomplete ordered job set yields incomplete status. Forced length may count emitted EOS; record actual IDs.
limitations: New sources are held out from local kernel/cone tuning, not from model training.
Lengths within a source share a source prefix and are correlated.
Code/prose tasks are not a public coding or general-quality benchmark.
Memory guard may shrink chunk sizes; unsupported geometry must fall back safely and is not fastpath coverage.
One131K pair is exploratory capacity/state evidence, not a long-context benchmark.

provenance.hardware: Apple M5 Ultra, 80 GPU cores, 256 GiB unified memory

research.idea: DSpark confidence scheduling; causal early stopping is required to avoid selection bias.
M5 cooperative tensor kernels primarily accelerate compute-bound prefill; do not assume decode gains.
FlashMoE expert-cache recency/frequency policies, relevant only when expert offload is needed.
Predict transfers rather than replacing expert routing; prediction misses should cost latency, not correctness.
Existing 1017 reference-arithmetic correction and exact metadata compression; prior art, not our novelty claim.
Closest published 1017/M5 Ultra/256GB baseline; author-reported, not locally reproduced yet.

The record fields are:

- **index** — the record number (`00000`, `00001`, …), a monotonically increasing sequence identifier.
- **queue** — an integer cycling through `0..12` (13 distinct values), advancing by 1 each record and wrapping.
- **phase** — an integer cycling through `0..30` (31 distinct values), advancing by 7 each record modulo 31.
- **checksum** — an integer that advances by `7919` each record modulo `104729` (a prime), so it wraps within `0..104728`.

- `mstate()` / `multistate()`: when entering `MSTATE_COMPLETED
